game_concept: A puzzle set in The Kingdom – Orchard Lane, the royal orchard lane: the knight must handle thieves while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Copy Cat: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when thieves strike.
theme: The Kingdom – Orchard Lane: the royal orchard lane
core_gameplay_loop: In Orchard Lane, repeat each round: Copy one variable into another and predict whether the original changes when thieves strike. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the b value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the royal seal using at most 14 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
win_condition: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 14.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 14 before the royal seal is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 8 (extended tier): Copy Cat
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Copy Cat' (Week 1 slot 10), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Orchard Lane'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how b changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thieves in Orchard Lane.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: The royal seal reached with actions_used <= 14.
